subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft — Stellarnet procurement timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emily Wallace <emily.wallace@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:32:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft — Stellarnet procurement timeline

Hi Emily / Team,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Goals we heard: replace legacy API gateway, reduce inference latency for customer-facing flows, and centralize model serving to reduce ops cost.
- Primary stakeholders: Emily (Procurement), Tom (Budget owner), Marcus (Tech lead) 
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence for data residency, 3rd-party legal standard redlines, and procurement windows aligned to monthly budget cycle.

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (Stellarnet_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners and a target close date. Highlights:

Milestones (proposed)
- Week 0: Finalize SOW scope (Owner: Emily / Procurement)
- Week 1: Security & SOC2 evidence review (Owner: Marcus / Tech)
- Week 2: Legal redline pass (Owner: Tom / Legal)
- Week 3: POC + perf validation (Owner: Redwood engineering lead)
- Week 4: Contract & signatures (Owner: Emily)

Proposed target close date: 2027-05-31 (we can shift if needed).
Dependencies: legal turnaround, SOC2 artifact access, internal budget approval (Tom).

Requested next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm the owners and target close date by EOD Monday (2027-05-17).
2) Marcus — can you confirm a timeframe for SOC2 artefacts (SSAE/SOC report or a pointer to your Security folder)?
3) Tom — do you expect any procurement window or approval cycle that would push the close beyond end of May?

I'll follow up with a copy to our CSM (Monica) so she can map onboarding milestones.

Attachments: Stellarnet_MAP_v1.xlsx (attachment)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0152

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft — Stellarnet procurement timeline

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap.

Quick notes after syncing with Tom and Marcus: we like the structure. A couple of asks before we sign off on owners/targets:

- I've attached a short PDF with legal redlines to the contract template (Stellarnet_REDLINE_v1.pdf). Can your legal team confirm acceptance or propose language?
- Target close: end-of-May is tight for us given our June budget lock; can we move target to 2027-06-10 to allow one extra procurement cycle?
- Marcus asked for the SOC2 report or a secure pointer — he needs it for the compliance review.

Tom is added to this thread as the budget owner. He also flagged that if legal redlines are extensive we'll need a one-week buffer.

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft — Stellarnet procurement timeline

Emily — thanks for the quick turn. Good call on shifting the target close. Per your ask I attached an updated MAP (Stellarnet_MAP_v1_1.xlsx) and included:

- Target close date moved to 2027-06-10.
- Legal redline item tracker with owner = Ben Carter (internal contact for legal coordination) assigned to review and propose language by 2027-05-20.
- SOC2 evidence: added a task for Marcus to post a pointer to the SOC2 report; Monica will validate the artifacts once posted.
- Added a dependency row for DocuSign pre-fill (we can pre-populate signatory names after SOW final).

Action items (please confirm by EOD 2027-05-17):
- Emily: confirm target close date 2027-06-10 and procurement cadence OK
- Tom: confirm any budget commit windows that would block the June 10 date
- Marcus: link or attach SOC2 artifacts (or a secure read-only path)

Related links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5421/stel-2027-045 
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Stellarnet-MAP

Attachments: Stellarnet_MAP_v1_1.xlsx (attachment)

If I don't hear confirmation I'll assume the June 10 window is acceptable and will lock the MAP owners accordingly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emily Wallace <emily.wallace@stellarnet.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP weekly checkpoint — Stellarnet (quick nudge)

Hi Emily / team — quick weekly checkpoint on the MAP we circulated last week.

Status summary (watchlist):
- Legal redlines (Ben) — NO RESPONSE from Stellarnet Legal; marked overdue (owner: Tom). Please advise ETA.
- SOC2 artifacts (Marcus) — pending; Marcus, can you share a pointer to the report or let us know if we should arrange a secure upload?
- Procurement window — Karthik tentatively moved target to 2027-06-10; we need explicit confirmation to prioritize engineering slots for the POC.

I've re-attached the most recent MAP (Stellarnet_MAP_v1_1.xlsx). In the sheet: red rows = overdue, amber = at-risk, green = on track.

Next requested actions by EOD 2027-05-21:
- Tom: confirm legal turnaround or provide redline acceptance to Ben.
- Marcus: post SOC2 pointer (or confirm secure handoff method).
- Emily: confirm whether June 10 remains the committed close so we can schedule resource reservations.

If we don't get confirmations by Friday we'll propose a new cadence and update the MAP accordingly. Appreciate the quick reply — happy to jump on a 15-min sync if that's easier to unblock.

Attachments: Stellarnet_MAP_v1_1.xlsx (attachment)

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
